steps.name: Columbian Tourist
steps.text: Spectacular! Show me another one!

steps.name: Columbian Tourist
steps.text: I daresay your skills would be no less impressive in Wrankwood, my friends.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Huh. The guy waving the sign around looks a bit familiar... Was he the one who performed in front of a restaurant near Rhine HQ?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Oh right, being right next door to a fast food joint was the Caravan International Travel Agency's selling point.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: But he was flipping that sign around way too fast for me to see what was on it.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Hot springs.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Oh... Uh, have you been there before?

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Nope, but I've seen more than enough outlanders shivering from the cold and asking where the hot springs are. That must be why they come here.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Heh, I'm actually pretty interested in those myself.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: When you're blessed by the Samivilinn, it's not so difficult to find a hot spring in the forest.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: While I haven't been to southern Sami in years, I've also heard that the locals often encounter anxious southerners on the road.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: They'll offer handfuls of unfashioned gold bars in exchange for divining the location of nearby hot springs.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: And do they get an answer?

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Hah. Who knows?

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: What I do know is that some people mistakenly believe that—because of the southerners' apparent fondness for such ugly ingots—they must never have developed any sense of aesthetics.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Then I guess... they never reached a mutual understanding.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: However, they did end up finding experienced people like yourself, and eventually discovered the hot springs on their own.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Take a look at that. The thing that's always singing.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Oh, an advertising truck.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: That's right. If you follow it all the way, you'll find another hot spring that they're developing.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: This sort of thing happens often.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: You're quite knowledgeable about this little town.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Of course. It's Sami soil.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Even without many strange occurrences people need my help with, it's not like I can't figure out what's happening.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Hmm... This place feels pretty different from the rest of Sami, though.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Where did I put my visitor's brochure again... Oh, found it.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: According to the map, everything from here to here is nothing but resorts for the tourists. There are hardly any Sami homes.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: The neighborhoods we've been walking through not only have electricity, good signal strength, and even intercity net, but... (*takes a deep breath*) Yeah, I smell water purifiers, too.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Considering this is where a lot of major tech company offices are concentrated, it makes sense that they'd want convenient communications...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: But the insides of the offices don't look much different from the ones at Rhine HQ.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Also, they're using steel beams and concrete to simulate the appearance of large trees, and putting their buildings on top of them. Isn't that offensive to the Sami?

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Probably not?

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: I can see why they do, though; your people are terrified of Sami, so they lock themselves in metal cages for protection.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Can't argue with that... Even for researchers like me who've gone into the icefield quite a few times, there's no way we can match how freely you can move around out there.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Don't worry. Even so, you are still connected to the land of Sami.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: That's what Arges always said.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: ...Magallan, do you mind if I take a look at that brochure of yours?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Go ahead, but I got it when I was entering the endless icefield from Ursus, so all the labels are in Ursine. What did you want to see? Maybe I can help you find it!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Oh, that's the wrong side. That's just an ad for an Ursus nursing home with a Sami resort.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: It's fine, Magallan. I can read it myself.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Here they are... The coordinates from the transmission.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: ...Excuse me, I have some business to take care of. Typhon, Magallan, I'm afraid we'll have to say goodbye for now.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Ehehe. Next time, I'll be setting off for the endless icefield from here, so I'm sure we'll meet again, Simone!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: If we run into any snowstorms though, please come back to save us!

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Haha, will do.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Next time, is it? ...That's right. After this little excursion is over, who knows where I might end up?

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: I wish you the best, Magallan.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Bye, Simone!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: What about you, Li'l Typhoon?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Rhine Lab's office is right around the corner from here, and I need to make a report.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: But... where's your client?

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: No idea.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: All Arges said was that someone's waiting for me in Čappat.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Still...

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Well... I suppose I'll just walk around for now. I'm sure I'll run into them.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Hm? Then how about you check over here?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Oh right, lemme give you some spare change! That way you'll be able to take the tour buses to get around town!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Alright, I'm off!

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Huh. And what the heck is 'Li'l Typhoon'?
Typhon raises her head and sees a tall, familiar-looking figure standing beneath the eaves.
The hunter, in all her vigilance, failed to notice when she got there.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Okay then. I think I figured it out.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: ...The person waiting for me might have been none other than Arges herself.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: Look who it is! If it isn't our little Maggy!

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: It's been forever since I heard your voice in the audio report archives, so we've been worried sick! We were just about ready to add your name to the search-and-rescue list!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Ehehe... My luck's actually been pretty good so far!

steps.name: Unfamiliar Researcher
steps.text: So, tired of energy bars and compressed biscuits yet? How about some flavorful Mama John's instant spicy beastmeat?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Oh, thanks!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Oh, but... Who might you be? Is that Beachbrella's logo on your clothes...?

steps.name: Beachbrella Field Staff
steps.text: There's no need to look so confused. While our logo might feel out of place in cold and frigid Sami, corporate printed us a special snow-themed pattern. See?

steps.name: Beachbrella Field Staff
steps.text: Almost everyone knows your name by now, Magallan. The rising star of icefield research! So experienced at exploration, and at such a young age!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Eh...

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: Hahaha! There's not much to do out here in Sami, so all us bored folks from the neighboring offices have gotten to know each other and share juicy gossip.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: Besides, several large companies with lots of employees registered with the Exploration Society will be getting together to conduct the search-and-rescue operation of Director Maryam and his expedition team.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: You came back at just the right time. Now that we've prepared both the manpower and the resources, all that's left is the firsthand data you've brought back.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: For whatever reason, I've got a really good feeling about this mission. I can't even picture the Director getting himself killed. He's so stubborn he might as well be some kind of immortal monster himself.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: According to his files and medical reports, he's always just been a regular Kuranta.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: But I also have faith he's still out there. Because... Uh, because I heard his voice when I was having auditory hallucinations along the way.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: Hallucinations?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Yeah... It's a long story.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: It'll probably take a while just to sort through the notes I took...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: For example, stay far away from black snow, and if you're hearing things, don't answer.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: And... near the endless icefield, on the Fjal Vetrtonn, there's a high wall made up of many fortresses filled with warriors.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I'm sure they're nice people, but it's best to keep your distance!

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: A high wall? Can Sami technology compete with Victoria's city defense artillery?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: No, the people here aren't too different from how they're depicted in the explorer's guidebook published by Ursus last century.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: No progress in a hundred years?! We've gone from barren wastes to multiple high-tech cities in less than that!

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: No wonder my colleagues in the Business Section always complain about how difficult it was to set up an office here, and how hard it is communicating with the Sami.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: But if the locals can overcome the difficult environment with only their own methods, then it should be a piece of cake for us.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Mm, I wouldn't be so sure of that.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I've encountered plenty of situations where I was in over my head. I wouldn't have made it without my friend from Rhodes Island!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Oh, and there was also a particularly nice hunter I met near the icefield.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: She was incredible, you know. She knew all of Sami like her own backyard, and was always glad to help.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Both of them had so many survival skills I've never seen before, and they saved my hide more than once.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: ...Anyway, if you still have enough supplies left over for the search-and-rescue operation, I'd like to apply to join the team.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I got a ton of information during this trip through Sami, and might not be able to sift through all of it on such short notice–

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: —Hwuhhhh? Typhon?!

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Good, you're still here.

steps.name: Arges
steps.text: Please do not doubt me, Typhon. I saw only a glimpse of fate.

steps.name: Arges
steps.text: Only that you came to this little town, and gave away a casket.

steps.name: Arges
steps.text: At the time I did not know where you got it from, what was inside it, or who was meant to receive it.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Yeah, I'm used to that by now.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: So you went and found it yourself, right?

steps.name: Arges
steps.text: After sending you off, I also embarked on a journey to fulfill my destiny, and to await its guidance.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: (*inhales*) ...You smell like snow dripping from the fir trees.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: You've come a long way. You crossed the icefield.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: You went... Mm. To places I've never been to before.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: (In Sarkaz) 'Surrender all to fate.'

steps.name: Arges
steps.text: (In Sarkaz) 'Surrender all to fate.'

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: It's great that you're the one to finally fulfill the prophecy.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Oh right, so where did you happen to get this little box?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: This is the nice person I was just talking about!

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Nice... person?

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: Oh, hello there!

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: I've heard you're quite familiar with Sami. And we happen to be putting together a search-and-rescue team to enter the icefield through Sami and locate missing Rhine Lab members.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: Do you think you could be persuaded to be our guide? We'll pay you handsomely!

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: I decline.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: If you need a guide, you'd better find someone else. I'm a hunter, and I have more important work.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: —Here, take this, Magallan.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Arges wanted me to give it to you. It belongs to Rhine Lab.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: To... us?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: —You're right, this is our logo.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: ID verification lock, employee number...

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: This is an equipment box from the Scientific Investigation Section.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: Judging from its size, it should be a general-purpose lockbox used for storing sensitive components.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: And the serial number...

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: ...Belongs to Director Maryam.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Wait, Typhon! Arges met with the research team?!

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Do you know the one this box belongs to?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: It's my teacher's, the leader of the missing research team!

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Hm. In other words, Arges worked together with the missing team.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Huh?!

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: Wait, if she was a firsthand witness, and even cooperated with Rhine Lab...

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: Then why hasn't she come to see us in person?

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Because that is the vision she saw.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: Vision—?

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: —Is she one of the legendary Cyclopes? Are there really living Cyclopes in Sami?

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: I have to meet her!

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: Does she speak any modern languages? Do we need some kind of ritual to summon her?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I... don't think she's all that different from us. She's pretty fond of Columbian geographical magazines.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: But I'd like to speak with her face-to-face, too... Is there no way?

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: She might just feel that this isn't the fated time yet.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Okay, but...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: What happened to the others, then?

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Mm, I'm sure you can already guess the answer.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: All Arges told me was that she entered the icefield with the expedition team.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: ...So, the extra supplies Professor Mary took from the Scientific Investigation station weren't just for emergency use, but for her.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Cyclopes can see the future, and she tried her best to help the team avoid danger.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: But a tragic end was inevitable... Well, that's her way of saying she did the best she could.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: After encountering the demons, only she and the box's owner survived.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: The professor would always tell us that when facing nature, our first priority was to survive.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: We've never had such a huge loss of life since the formation of Scientific Investigation... And he must be even more devastated than us.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: ...So this is the endless icefield.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Typhon, did the survivor return with Arges?

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: (Shakes head)

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: He continued to advance deeper in, alone.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I knew it...

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: That... sure sounds like Director Maryam.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Also, I have some words to pass on.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: First, Arges wanted me to apologize to you.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Second, the person who gave her the box said... 'The journey of discovery must never end.'

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Hmm, I wonder what's inside the box.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Just a flower?

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: We're currently cross-analyzing the chemical structure of the environmental particles stuck to the specimen box.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: However, we know very little about the endless icefield, and it may be difficult to determine the missing team's location based on this alone.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: If no matching data can be found... does that mean that the Director pushed the boundaries of human exploration into the icefield?

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: I believe so. Which is why this flower is an extremely valuable specimen.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Mhm. In all my time exploring the icefield, I've never seen anything like this.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Though, I have seen an entire field of flowers underground. The environment down there was pretty unique to be able to support plant growth!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: But this particular flower...
Magallan carefully observes it through the display window of the specimen box.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: ...It looks really strange, almost like it isn't a plant at all.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: The flowers I dug up before had robust root systems to allow them to absorb nutrients from beneath the ice.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: But... where are the roots on this?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Someone as careful as the Director wouldn't have damaged the specimen during collection. That would significantly reduce its research value.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: Let's start with basic observations. Given the conditions here, we probably won't get any results right away.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: To conduct the next phase of research, we'll have to wait until the sample is transported back to HQ and passed on to Ecological for handling.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: A special Messenger will arrive in Čappat shortly.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: We can leave the in-depth study of the specimen to them. We still need to contact Director Maryam as soon as possible.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: By the way, Magallan, are you sure you want to head right back out on another trek? Your protective gear needs maintenance, and we won't be able to get any spare drones in Sami within three days.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Hmm... But I'm worried about the Director.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Besides, my protective gear is still in good shape. After all, I was only passing through Sami, not heading deep into the icefield.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: Haha, there's really no stopping you.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: Alright, then I'm going to break the specimen box's seal.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Understood. Please begin reporting your findings whenever. I'm ready to record!
It was colorless flower, like a shadow cast by ice.
But the moment the box was unsealed, the invisible air throughout the laboratory was dyed with myriad colors.
It identified its current space, reoriented its position, and established its own territory.
The Columbian researchers had no time to react. They did not realize they were being contaminated along with the entire lab, nor did they hear the thunderous noise that shattered the dead silence.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: —Wake up!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: *gasp*!

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: *cough* *cough* Wh-What happened?!

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: Oh no, the wall... The glass is all shattered too. And, wh-wh-who are you? Who said you could barge in here?

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Don't move.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: ...Phew! I've finished sealing the flower, Typhon! That should be good enough, right?

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Yeah. Your react much faster than before.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Does this mean...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Oh.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: 'When the box is opened, Andskotarnir will realize.'

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: ...We've already opened the box.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Task Force Messenger
steps.text: Th-This is the Sami branch office, right? What's going on in here?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Uh, something dangerous.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: ...Or, you could call it a major discovery.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: A completely new type of plant. Or even a completely new type of phenomenon!

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: Hah. Director Maryam really sent us an amazing gift.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: But, something's off...

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: If Director Maryam and Arges knew this flower was so dangerous, why did they send it back anyway?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Why didn't the Director try to stop us from studying it?

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: What kind of question is that? Since when do explorers fear danger?

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: A phenomenon that flies in the face of everything we take as common sense... This is an absolute scientific gold mine!

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: Should we prioritize forming a larger team to study it in-depth?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Um, I think our search-and-rescue come first. We'll locate Director Maryam, and simultaneously open up a route for those who come afterwards.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Oh right, we also need to hurry up and ask the Director what he wants to name this new plant species.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I'll record a description to submit as a report. Please take my recording back along with the sample, Mr. Messenger.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: Also, have HQ submit a report to the Exploration Society announcing this discovery as soon as possible!

steps.name: Rhine Lab Task Force Messenger
steps.text: ...Understood.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: I have to admit, the Exploration Society is much more efficient at getting teams together for this kind of thing.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: Some of them don't even have the patience gather a team. You know who I mean, Magallan, like those explorers famous for preferring to work alone.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Yeah, some of them are my good friends. Even if you're always making fun of them.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: But this discovery is much more valuable than any of my previous explorations.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: I think this joint venture will attract not only explorers, but also researchers in the fields of biology, geology, and meteorology to join the expedition. More and more people will become interested in the icefield.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: Haha, once we're back from the rescue operation, things might get so busy here we won't even recognize the place.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: How are you feeling, Magallan?

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: I remember you mentioning before that you wanted to see if this so-called endless icefield really does have an end.

steps.name: Rhine Lab Researcher
steps.text: Well, now you're one step closer to your dream!

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Well, that's hard to say...
Before Magallan can join her colleagues in celebration, she feels Typhon tugging on her hand.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: ...Huh?

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: (You want to talk to me... outside?)

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: What's wrong?

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Well, Arges said there was no point trying to stop you, because you might find a way to discover everything about Sami on your own.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: Just as Sami's warriors are willing to sacrifice their lives to hold the northern front, the southerners—yet to receive the revelation of their destiny—will continue exploring to lift the veil from this land at any cost.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: But before you people get too caught up in your fantasies, I have to remind you of something.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: This is also so you don't wind up as misfortunate as Arges said.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: Misfortunate?

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: ...The Cyclopes's vision. The last thing she saw was a tragic ending.

steps.name: Typhon
steps.text: If you're ever in trouble, find me.

steps.name: Magallan
steps.text: ...Thank you.
Magallan suddenly feels a slight chill.
She turns her head, and inexplicably, a snowstorm is raging outside the window.

steps.name: Suspicious Liberi
steps.text: *cough* *cough*, *cough*... Hah...

steps.name: Suspicious Liberi
steps.text: You... understand the feeling of pain very well. More than most Sami, who've resigned themselves to it... *cough*, *cough*...

steps.name: Suspicious Liberi
steps.text: You understand how to torture someone. You Sami beasts... have no shortage of tricks.

steps.name: Suspicious Liberi
steps.text: Urgh... *cough*, *cough*... Hah... Engulfed in your witchcraft, I can't even feel the pain of being pierced by an ice pick.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: I just want a clear answer.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: What is the Black Mark, and why have you smuggled in? Answer me.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: I can always end this sooner.

steps.name: Suspicious Liberi
steps.text: Hah... Hahaha. You'll regret this, witch. Letting me die here... will do nothing but make Sami suffer more!

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Sami does not care about your foolish ambitions.

steps.name: Suspicious Liberi
steps.text: Ambitions? Hardly.

steps.name: Suspicious Liberi
steps.text: I've come here to die, and I'm more than happy to do so!

steps.name: Suspicious Liberi
steps.text: This information... will never be sent back to Ursus. And you'll regret it.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: ...Speak.

steps.name: Suspicious Liberi
steps.text: The Black Mark... is a missing member of the Emperor's Royal Guard.

steps.name: Suspicious Liberi
steps.text: I found his footprints. Black footprints.

steps.name: Suspicious Liberi
steps.text: His Dominion has collapsed. The demons have completely taken him... Hah, he will contaminate your land for all of eternity!

steps.name: Suspicious Liberi
steps.text: And nobody alive... knows where he is now.

steps.name: Suspicious Liberi
steps.text: You— Urgh—!

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Let these words linger in your ears before the cold takes away your consciousness forevermore.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: The Sami know neither fear nor panic.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: We have guarded the mountains for hundreds of years. We are Sami's fangs, to sever the demons' tracks.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: You and your ilk... are not even 'enemies.'

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: ...The affairs of the Ursus end here.

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: Haha. O Fate, your warning has once again drawn my gaze back to the contaminated land of Sami...

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: How could I have ever forgotten my duty?

steps.name: Santalla
steps.text: I understand now, that is time for me to return to the wind and snow of the icefield.
